answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the haven checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The knoll graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the dawn audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 2 times its size, so a group of 27 keys loses far more than 27 single identities would. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
